title: Leviticus 25:24
text: Wherever there is property in land, the owner is to have the right of getting it back.

title: Leviticus 25:25
text: If your brother becomes poor, and has to give up some of his land for money, his nearest relation may come and get back that which his brother has given up.

title: Leviticus 25:26
text: And if he has no one to get it back for him, and later he himself gets wealth and has enough money to get it back;

title: Leviticus 25:27
text: Then let him take into account the years from the time when he gave it up, and make up the loss for the rest of the years to him who took it, and so get back his property.

title: Leviticus 25:28
text: But if he is not able to get it back for himself, then it will be kept by him who gave a price for it, till the year of Jubilee; and in that year it will go back to its first owner and he will have his property again.

title: Leviticus 25:29
text: And if a man gives his house in a walled town for money, he has the right to get it back for the space of a full year after he has given it up.

title: Leviticus 25:30
text: And if he does not get it back by the end of the year, then the house in the town will become the property of him who gave the money for it, and of his children for ever; it will not go from him in the year of Jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:31
text: But houses in small unwalled towns will be the same as property in the country; they may be got back, and they will go back to their owners in the year of Jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:32
text: But the houses in the towns of the Levites may be got back by the Levites at any time.

title: Leviticus 25:33
text: And if a Levite does not give money to get back his property, his house in the town which was exchanged for money will come back to him in the year of Jubilee. For the houses of the towns of the Levites are their property among the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 25:34
text: But the land on the outskirts of their towns may not be exchanged for money, for it is their property for ever.

title: Leviticus 25:35
text: And if your brother becomes poor and is not able to make a living, then you are to keep him with you, helping him as you would a man from another country who is living among you.

title: Leviticus 25:36
text: Take no interest from him, in money or in goods, but have the fear of your God before you, and let your brother make a living among you.

title: Leviticus 25:37
text: Do not take interest on the money which you let him have or on the food which you give him.

title: Leviticus 25:38
text: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, that I might be your God.

title: Leviticus 25:39
text: ¶And if your brother becomes poor and gives himself to you for money, do not make use of him like a servant who is your property;

title: Leviticus 25:40
text: But let him be with you as a servant working for payment, till the year of Jubilee;

title: Leviticus 25:41
text: Then he will go out from you, he and his children with him, and go back to his family and to the property of his fathers.

title: Leviticus 25:42
text: For they are my servants whom I took out from the land of Egypt; they may not become the property of another.

title: Leviticus 25:43
text: Do not be a hard master to him, but have the fear of God before you.

title: Leviticus 25:44
text: But you may get servants as property from among the nations round about; from them you may take men-servants and women-servants.

title: Leviticus 25:45
text: And in addition, you may get, for money, servants from among the children of other nations who are living with you, and from their families which have come to birth in your land; and these will be your property.

title: Leviticus 25:46
text: And they will be your children's heritage after you, to keep as their property; they will be your servants for ever; but you may not be hard masters to your countrymen, the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 25:47
text: And if one from another nation living among you gets wealth, and your countryman, at his side, becomes poor and gives himself for money to the man from another nation or to one of his family;

title: Leviticus 25:48
text: After he has given himself he has the right to be made free, for a price, by one of his brothers,

title: Leviticus 25:49
text: Or his father's brother, or the son of his father's brother, or any near relation; or if he gets money, he may make himself free.

title: Leviticus 25:50
text: And let the years be numbered from the time when he gave himself to his owner till the year of Jubilee, and the price given for him will be in relation to the number of years, on the scale of the payment of a servant.

title: Leviticus 25:51
text: If there is still a long time, he will give back, on account of it, a part of the price which was given for him.

title: Leviticus 25:52
text: And if there is only a short time, he will take account of it with his master, and in relation to the number of years he will give back the price of making him free.

title: Leviticus 25:53
text: And he will be with him as a servant working for payment year by year; his master is not to be cruel to him before your eyes.

title: Leviticus 25:54
text: And if he is not made free in this way, he will go out in the year of Jubilee, he and his children with him.

title: Leviticus 25:55
text: For the children of Israel are servants to me; they are my servants whom I took out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 26:1
text: ¶Do not make images of false gods, or put up an image cut in stone or a pillar or any pictured stone in your land, to give worship to it; for I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 26:2
text: Keep my Sabbaths and give honour to my holy place: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 26:3
text: If you are guided by my rules, and keep my laws and do them,

title: Leviticus 26:4
text: Then I will give you rain at the right time, and the land will give her increase and the trees of the field will give their fruit;

title: Leviticus 26:5
text: And the crushing of the grain will overtake the cutting of the grapes, and the cutting of the grapes will overtake the planting of the seed, and there will be bread in full measure, and you will be living in your land safely.

title: Leviticus 26:6
text: And I will give you peace in the land, and you will take your rest and no one will give you cause for fear; and I will put an end to all evil beasts in the land, and no sword of war will go through your land.

title: Leviticus 26:7
text: And you will put to flight those who are against you, and they will be put to death by your swords.

title: Leviticus 26:8
text: Then five of you will put to flight a hundred, and a hundred of you will put to flight ten thousand, and all who are against you will be put to death by your swords.

title: Leviticus 26:9
text: And I will have pleasure in you and make you fertile and greater in number; and I will keep my agreement with you.

title: Leviticus 26:10
text: And old stores long kept will be your food, and you will take out the old because of the new;

title: Leviticus 26:11
text: And I will put my holy House among you, and my soul will not be turned away from you in disgust.

title: Leviticus 26:12
text: And I will be present among you and will be your God and you will be my people.

title: Leviticus 26:13
text: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt so that you might not be servants to them; by me the cords of your yoke were broken and I made you go upright.

title: Leviticus 26:14
text: ¶But if you do not give ear to me, and do not keep all these my laws;

title: Leviticus 26:15
text: And if you go against my rules and if you have hate in your souls for my decisions and you do not do all my orders, but go against my agreement;

title: Leviticus 26:16
text: This will I do to you: I will put fear in your hearts, even wasting disease and burning pain, drying up the eyes and making the soul feeble, and you will get no profit from your seed, for your haters will take it for food.

title: Leviticus 26:17
text: And my face will be turned from you, and you will be broken before those who are against you, and your haters will become your rulers, and you will go in flight when no man comes after you.

title: Leviticus 26:18
text: And if, even after these things, you will not give ear to me, then I will send you punishment seven times more for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:19
text: And the pride of your strength will be broken, and I will make your heaven as iron and your earth as brass;

title: Leviticus 26:20
text: And your strength will be used up without profit; for your land will not give her increase and the trees of the field will not give their fruit.

title: Leviticus 26:21
text: And if you still go against me and will not give ear to me, I will put seven times more punishments on you because of your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:22
text: I will let loose the beasts of the field among you, and they will take away your children and send destruction on your cattle, so that your numbers will become small and your roads become waste.

title: Leviticus 26:23
text: And if by these things you will not be turned to me, but still go against me;

title: Leviticus 26:24
text: Then I will go against you, and I will give you punishment, I myself, seven times for all your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:25
text: And I will send a sword on you to give effect to the punishment of my agreement; and when you come together into your towns I will send disease among you and you will be given up into the hands of your haters.

title: Leviticus 26:26
text: When I take away your bread of life, ten women will be cooking bread in one oven, and your bread will be measured out by weight; you will have food but never enough.

title: Leviticus 26:27
text: And if, after all this, you do not give ear to me, but go against me still,

title: Leviticus 26:28
text: Then my wrath will be burning against you, and I will give you punishment, I myself, seven times for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:29
text: Then you will take the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters for food;

title: Leviticus 26:30
text: And I will send destruction on your high places, overturning your perfume altars, and will put your dead bodies on your broken images, and my soul will be turned from you in disgust.

title: Leviticus 26:31
text: And I will make your towns waste and send destruction on your holy places; I will take no pleasure in the smell of your sweet perfumes;

title: Leviticus 26:32
text: And I will make your land a waste, a wonder to your haters living in it.

title: Leviticus 26:33
text: And I will send you out in all directions among the nations, and my sword will be uncovered against you, and your land will be without any living thing, and your towns will be made waste.

title: Leviticus 26:34
text: Then will the land take pleasure in its Sabbaths while it is waste and you are living in the land of your haters; then will the land have rest.

title: Leviticus 26:35
text: All the days while it is waste will the land have rest, such rest as it never had in your Sabbaths, when you were living in it.

title: Leviticus 26:36
text: And as for the rest of you, I will make their hearts feeble in the land of their haters, and the sound of a leaf moved by the wind will send them in flight, and they will go in flight as from the sword, falling down when no one comes after them;

title: Leviticus 26:37
text: Falling on one another, as before the sword, when no one comes after them; you will give way before your haters.

title: Leviticus 26:38
text: And death will overtake you among strange nations, and the land of your haters will be your destruction.

title: Leviticus 26:39
text: And those of you who are still living will be wasting away in their sins in the land of your haters; in the sins of their fathers they will be wasting away.

title: Leviticus 26:40
text: ¶And they will have grief for their sins and for the sins of their fathers, when their hearts were untrue to me, and they went against me;

title: Leviticus 26:41
text: So that I went against them and sent them away into the land of their haters: if then the pride of their hearts is broken and they take the punishment of their sins,

title: Leviticus 26:42
text: Then I will keep in mind the agreement which I made with Jacob and with Isaac and with Abraham, and I will keep in mind the land.

title: Leviticus 26:43
text: And the land, while she is without them, will keep her Sabbaths; and they will undergo the punishment of their sins, because they were turned away from my decisions and in their souls was hate for my laws.

title: Leviticus 26:44
text: But for all that, when they are in the land of their haters I will not let them go, or be turned away from them, or give them up completely; my agreement with them will not be broken, for I am the Lord their God.

title: Leviticus 26:45
text: And because of them I will keep in mind the agreement which I made with their fathers, whom I took out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations, to be their God: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 26:46
text: These are the rules, decisions, and laws, which the Lord made between himself and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai, by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 27:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 27:2
text: Say to the children of Israel, If a man makes a special oath, you will give your decision as to the value of the persons for the Lord.

title: Leviticus 27:3
text: And you will put the value of a male from twenty years to sixty years old at fifty shekels of silver, by the scale of the holy place.

title: Leviticus 27:4
text: And if it is a female, the value will be thirty shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:5
text: And if the person is from five to twenty years old, the value will be twenty shekels for a male, and ten for a female.

title: Leviticus 27:6
text: And if the person is from one month to five years old, then the value for a male will be five shekels of silver, and for a female three shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:7
text: And for sixty years old and over, for a male the value will be fifteen shekels, and for a female, ten.

title: Leviticus 27:8
text: But if he is poorer than the value which you have put on him, then let him be taken to the priest, and the priest will put a value on him, such as it is possible for him to give.

title: Leviticus 27:9
text: And if it is a beast of which men make offerings to the Lord, whatever any man gives of such to the Lord will be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:10
text: It may not be changed in any way, a good given for a bad, or a bad for a good; if one beast is changed for another, the two will be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:11
text: And if it is any unclean beast, of which offerings are not made to the Lord, then let him take the beast before the priest;

title: Leviticus 27:12
text: And let the priest put a value on it, if it is good or bad; whatever value the priest puts on it, so will it be.

title: Leviticus 27:13
text: But if he has a desire to get it back for himself, let him give a fifth more than your value.

title: Leviticus 27:14
text: ¶And if a man has given his house as holy to the Lord, then the priest will put a value on it, if it is good or bad; as the priest gives decision so will the value be fixed.

title: Leviticus 27:15
text: And if the owner has a desire to get back his house, let him give a fifth more than your value, and it will be his.

title: Leviticus 27:16
text: And if a man gives to the Lord part of the field which is his property, then let your value be in relation to the seed which is planted in it; a measure of barley grain will be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

title: Leviticus 27:17
text: If he gives his field from the year of Jubilee, the value will be fixed by your decision.

title: Leviticus 27:18
text: But if he gives his field after the year of Jubilee, the amount of the money will be worked out by the priest in relation to the number of years till the coming year of Jubilee, and the necessary amount will be taken off your value.

title: Leviticus 27:19
text: And if the man who has given the field has a desire to get it back, let him give a fifth more than the price at which it was valued and it will be his.

title: Leviticus 27:20
text: But if he has no desire to get it back, or if he has given it for a price to another man, it may not be got back again.

title: Leviticus 27:21
text: But the field, when it becomes free at the year of Jubilee, will be holy to the Lord, as a field given under oath: it will be the property of the priest.

title: Leviticus 27:22
text: And if a man gives to the Lord a field which he has got for money from another, which is not part of his heritage;

title: Leviticus 27:23
text: Then the value fixed by you up to the year of Jubilee will be worked out for him by the priest, and in that day he will give the amount of your value as holy to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 27:24
text: In the year of Jubilee the field will go back to him from whom he got it, that is, to him whose heritage it was.

title: Leviticus 27:25
text: And let all your values be based on the shekel of the holy place, that is, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

title: Leviticus 27:26
text: ¶But a man may not give by oath to the Lord the first-fruits of cattle which are offered to the Lord: if it is an ox or a sheep it is the Lord's.

title: Leviticus 27:27
text: And if it is an unclean beast, then the owner of it may give money to get it back, in agreement with the value fixed by you, by giving a fifth more; or if it is not taken back, let it be given for money in agreement with your valuing.

title: Leviticus 27:28
text: But nothing which a man has given completely to the Lord, out of all his property, of man or beast, or of the land which is his heritage, may be given away or got back in exchange for money; anything completely given is most holy to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 27:29
text: Any man given completely to the Lord may not be got back: he is certainly to be put to death.

title: Leviticus 27:30
text: And every tenth part of the land, of the seed planted, or of the fruit of trees, is holy to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 27:31
text: And if a man has a desire to get back any of the tenth part which he has given, let him give a fifth more.

title: Leviticus 27:32
text: And a tenth part of the herd and of the flock, whatever goes under the rod of the valuer, will be holy to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 27:33
text: He may not make search to see if it is good or bad, or make any changes in it; and if he makes exchange of it for another, the two will be holy; he will not get them back again.

title: Leviticus 27:34
text: These are the orders which the Lord gave to Moses for the children of Israel in Mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai, in the Tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt,

title: Numbers 1:2
text: Take the full number of the children of Israel, by their families, and by their fathers' houses, every male by name;

title: Numbers 1:3
text: All those of twenty years old and over, who are able to go to war in Israel, are to be numbered by you and Aaron.

title: Numbers 1:4
text: And to give you help, take one man from every tribe, the head of his father's house.

title: Numbers 1:5
text: These are the names of those who are to be your helpers: from Reuben, Elizur, the son of Shedeur;

title: Numbers 1:6
text: From Simeon, Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai;

title: Numbers 1:7
text: From Judah, Nahshon, the son of Amminadab;

title: Numbers 1:8
text: From Issachar, Nethanel, the son of Zuar;

title: Numbers 1:9
text: From Zebulun, Eliab, the son of Helon;

title: Numbers 1:10
text: Of the children of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama, the son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur,

title: Numbers 1:11
text: From Benjamin, Abidan, the son of Gideoni;

title: Numbers 1:12
text: From Dan, Ahiezer, the son of Ammi-shaddai;

title: Numbers 1:13
text: From Asher, Pagiel, the son of Ochran;

title: Numbers 1:14
text: From Gad, Eliasaph, the son of Reuel;

title: Numbers 1:15
text: From Naphtali, Ahira, the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 1:16
text: These are the men named out of all the people, chiefs of their fathers' houses, heads of the tribes of Israel.

title: Numbers 1:17
text: ¶And Moses and Aaron took these men, marked out by name;

title: Numbers 1:18
text: And they got together all the people on the first day of the second month; and everyone made clear his family and his father's house, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and over.

title: Numbers 1:19
text: As the Lord had given orders to Moses, so they were numbered by him in the waste place of Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:20
text: The generations of the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:21
text: Forty-six thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Reuben were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:22
text: The generations of the sons of Simeon were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:23
text: Fifty-nine thousand, three hundred of the tribe of Simeon were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:24
text: The generations of the sons of Gad were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:25
text: Forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty of the tribe of Gad were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:26
text: The generations of the sons of Judah were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:27
text: Seventy-four thousand, six hundred of the tribe of Judah were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:28
text: The generations of the sons of Issachar were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:29
text: Fifty-four thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Issachar were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:30
text: The generations of the sons of Zebulun were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:31
text: Fifty-seven thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Zebulun were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:32
text: The generations of the sons of Joseph were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:33
text: Forty thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Ephraim were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:34
text: The generations of the sons of Manasseh were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:35
text: Thirty-two thousand, two hundred of the tribe of Manasseh were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:36
text: The generations of the sons of Benjamin were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:37
text: Thirty-five thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Benjamin were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:38
text: The generations of the sons of Dan were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:39
text: Sixty-two thousand, seven hundred of the tribe of Dan were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:40
text: The generations of the sons of Asher were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:41
text: Forty-one thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Asher were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:42
text: The generations of the sons of Naphtali were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

title: Numbers 1:43
text: Fifty-three thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Naphtali were numbered.

title: Numbers 1:44
text: ¶These are they who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and by the twelve chiefs of Israel, one from every tribe.

title: Numbers 1:45
text: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel, by their families, all those of twenty years old and over who were able to go to war,

title: Numbers 1:46
text: Were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 1:47
text: ¶But the Levites, of the tribe of their fathers, were not numbered among them.

title: Numbers 1:48
text: For the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 1:49
text: Only the tribe of Levi is not to be numbered among the children of Israel,

title: Numbers 1:50
text: But to them you are to give the care of the Tent of meeting with its vessels and everything in it: they are to take up the Tent, and be responsible for everything to do with it, and put up their tents round it.

title: Numbers 1:51
text: And when the Tent of meeting goes forward, the Levites are to take it down; and when it is to be put up, they are to do it: any strange person who comes near it is to be put to death.

title: Numbers 1:52
text: The children of Israel are to put up their tents, every man in his tent-circle round his flag.

title: Numbers 1:53
text: But the tents of the Levites are to be round the Tent of meeting, so that wrath may not come on the children of Israel: the Tent of meeting is to be in the care of the Levites.

title: Numbers 1:54
text: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

title: Numbers 2:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

title: Numbers 2:2
text: The children of Israel are to put up their tents in the order of their families, by the flags of their fathers' houses, facing the Tent of meeting on every side.

title: Numbers 2:3
text: ¶Those whose tents are on the east side, looking to the dawn, will be round the flag of the children of Judah, with Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:4
text: The number of his army was seventy-four thousand, six hundred.

title: Numbers 2:5
text: And nearest to him will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel, the son of Zuar, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:6
text: The number of his army was fifty-four thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:7
text: After him, the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab, the son of Helon, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:8
text: The number of his army was fifty-seven thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:9
text: The number of all the armies of Judah was a hundred and eighty-six thousand, four hundred. They go forward first.

title: Numbers 2:10
text: On the south side is the flag of the children of Reuben, in the order of their armies, with Elizur, the son of Shedeur, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:11
text: The number of his army was forty-six thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:12
text: And nearest to him, the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:13
text: The number of his army was fifty-nine thousand, three hundred.

title: Numbers 2:14
text: Then the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph, son of Reuel, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:15
text: The number of his army was forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:16
text: The number of all the armies of Reuben together came to a hundred and fifty-one thousand, four hundred and fifty. They go forward second.

title: Numbers 2:17
text: Then the Tent of meeting is to go forward, with the tents of the Levites, in the middle of the armies; in the same order as their tents are placed, they are to go forward, every man under his flag.

title: Numbers 2:18
text: On the west side will be the flag of the children of Ephraim, with Elishama, the son of Ammihud, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:19
text: The number of his army was forty thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:20
text: And by him the tribe of Manasseh with Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:21
text: The number of his army was thirty-two thousand, two hundred.

title: Numbers 2:22
text: Then the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan, the son of Gideoni, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:23
text: The number of his army was thirty-five thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:24
text: The number of all the armies of Ephraim was a hundred and eight thousand, one hundred. They go forward third.

title: Numbers 2:25
text: On the north side will be the flag of the children of Dan, with Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:26
text: The number of his army was sixty-two thousand, seven hundred.

title: Numbers 2:27
text: Nearest to him will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel, the son of Ochran, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:28
text: The number of his army was forty-one thousand, five hundred;

title: Numbers 2:29
text: Then the tribe of Naphtali, with Ahira, the son of Enan, as their chief.

title: Numbers 2:30
text: The number of his army was fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:31
text: The number of all the armies in the tents of Dan was a hundred and fifty-seven thousand, six hundred. They will go forward last, by their flags.

title: Numbers 2:32
text: These are all who were numbered of the children of Israel, in the order of their fathers' families: all the armies in their tents together came to six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:33
text: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, as the Lord said to Moses.

title: Numbers 2:34
text: So the children of Israel did as the Lord said to Moses, so they put up their tents by their flags, and they went forward in the same order, by their families, and by their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 3:1
text: ¶Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses, in the day when the word of the Lord came to Moses on Mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 3:2
text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the oldest, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

title: Numbers 3:3
text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests, on whom the holy oil was put, who were marked out as priests.

title: Numbers 3:4
text: And Nadab and Abihu were put to death before the Lord when they made an offering of strange fire before the Lord, in the waste land of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar did the work of priests before Aaron their father.

title: Numbers 3:5
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 3:6
text: Make the tribe of Levi come near, and put them before Aaron the priest, to be his helpers,

title: Numbers 3:7
text: In order that they may be responsible to him and to all Israel for the care of the Tent of meeting, and to do the work of the House;

title: Numbers 3:8
text: And they will have the care of all the vessels of the Tent of meeting, and will do for the children of Israel all the necessary work of the House.

title: Numbers 3:9
text: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; so that they may be his without question from among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:10
text: And give orders that Aaron and his sons are to keep their place as priests; any strange person who comes near is to be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:11
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 3:12
text: See, I have taken the Levites out of the children of Israel to be mine in place of the first sons of the children of Israel;

title: Numbers 3:13
text: For all the first sons are mine; on the day when I put to death all the first sons in the land of Egypt, I took for myself every first male birth of man and beast. They are mine; I am the Lord.

title: Numbers 3:14
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai,

title: Numbers 3:15
text: Let all the children of Levi be numbered by their families and their fathers' houses; let every male of a month old and over be numbered.

title: Numbers 3:16
text: So Moses did as the Lord said, numbering them as he had been ordered.

title: Numbers 3:17
text: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.

title: Numbers 3:18
text: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon, by their families: Libni and Shimei.

title: Numbers 3:19
text: And the sons of Kohath, by their families: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:20
text: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites in the order of their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 3:21
text: From Gershon come the Libnites and the Shimeites; these are the families of the Gershonites.

title: Numbers 3:22
text: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were seven thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 3:23
text: The tents of the Gershonites are to be placed at the back of the House, to the west.

title: Numbers 3:24
text: The chief of the Gershonites is Eliasaph, the son of Lael.

title: Numbers 3:25
text: In the Tent of meeting, the Gershonites are to have the care of the House, and the Tent with its cover, and the veil for the door of the Tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 3:26
text: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, and all the cords needed for its use.

title: Numbers 3:27
text: From Kohath come the Amramites and the Izharites and the Hebronites and the Uzzielites; these are the families of the Kohathites.

title: Numbers 3:28
text: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were eight thousand, six hundred, who were responsible for the care of the holy place.

title: Numbers 3:29
text: The tents of the Kohathites are to be placed on the south side of the House.

title: Numbers 3:30
text: Their chief is Elizaphan, the son of Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:31
text: In their care are the ark, and the table, and the lights, and the altars, and all the vessels used in the holy place, and the veil, and all they are used for.

title: Numbers 3:32
text: Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, will be head over all the Levites and overseer of those responsible for the care of the holy place.

title: Numbers 3:33
text: From Merari come the Mahlites and the Mushites; these are the families of Merari.

title: Numbers 3:34
text: Those who were numbered of them, the males of a month old and over, were six thousand, two hundred.

title: Numbers 3:35
text: The chief of the families of Merari was Zuriel, the son of Abihail: their tents are to be placed on the north side of the House.

title: Numbers 3:36
text: And in their care are to be all the boards of the Tent, with their rods and pillars and bases, and all the instruments, and all they are used for,

title: Numbers 3:37
text: And the pillars of the open space round it, with their bases and nails and cords.

title: Numbers 3:38
text: And those whose tents are to be placed on the east side of the House in front of the Tent of meeting, looking to the dawn, are Moses and Aaron and his sons, who will do the work of the holy place for the children of Israel; and any strange person who comes near will be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:39
text: All the Levites numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord, all the males of one month old and over numbered in the order of their families, were twenty-two thousand.

title: Numbers 3:40
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses, Let all the first male children be numbered, and take the number of their names.

title: Numbers 3:41
text: And give to me the Levites (I am the Lord) in place of the first sons of the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites in place of the first births among the cattle of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:42
text: So Moses had all the first sons among the children of Israel numbered, as the Lord said to him.

title: Numbers 3:43
text: Every first son from a month old and over was numbered by name, and the number came to twenty-two thousand, two hundred and seventy-three.

title: Numbers 3:44
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 3:45
text: Take the Levites in place of all the first sons of the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle; the Levites are to be mine; I am the Lord.

title: Numbers 3:46
text: And the price you have to give for the two hundred and seventy-three first sons of the children of Israel which are in addition to the number of the Levites,

title: Numbers 3:47
text: Will be five shekels for every one, by the scale of the holy place (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

title: Numbers 3:48
text: And this money, the price of those over the number of the Levites, is to be given to Aaron and his sons.

title: Numbers 3:49
text: So Moses took the money, the price of those whose place had not been taken by the Levites;

title: Numbers 3:50
text: From the first sons of Israel he took it, a thousand, three hundred and sixty-five shekels, by the scale of the holy place;

title: Numbers 3:51
text: And he gave the money to Aaron and his sons, as the Lord had said.

title: Numbers 4:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

title: Numbers 4:2
text: Let the sons of Kohath, from among the sons of Levi, be numbered by their families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

title: Numbers 4:3
text: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:4
text: And this is to be the work of the sons of Kohath in connection with the most holy things.

title: Numbers 4:5
text: When all the people go forward, Aaron is to go in with his sons, and take down the veil of the curtain, covering the ark of witness with it;

title: Numbers 4:6
text: And putting over it the leather cover and over that a blue cloth; and putting its rods in place.

title: Numbers 4:7
text: And on the table of the holy bread they are to put a blue cloth, and on it all the vessels, the spoons and the basins and the cups; and the holy bread with them;

title: Numbers 4:8
text: And over them they are to put a red cloth, covering it with a leather cover, and putting its rods in their places.

title: Numbers 4:9
text: And they are to take a blue cloth, covering with it the light-support with its lights and its instruments and its trays and all the oil vessels which are used for it:

title: Numbers 4:10
text: All these they are to put in a leather cover, and put it on the frame.

title: Numbers 4:11
text: On the gold altar they are to put a blue cloth, covering it with a leather cover; and they are to put its rods in their places.

title: Numbers 4:12
text: All the vessels which are used in the holy place they are to put in a blue cloth, covering them with a leather cover, and put them on the frame.

title: Numbers 4:13
text: And they are to take away the burned waste from the altar, and put a purple cloth on it;

title: Numbers 4:14
text: Placing on the cloth all its vessels, the fire-baskets, the meat-hooks, the spades, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; they are to put a leather cover over all these, and put its rods in their places.

title: Numbers 4:15
text: And after the holy place and all its vessels have been covered up by Aaron and his sons, when the tents of the people go forward, the sons of Kohath are to come and take it up; but the holy things may not be touched by them for fear of death.

title: Numbers 4:16
text: And Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, is to be responsible for the oil for the light, and the sweet perfumes for burning, and the regular meal offering, and the holy oil; the House and the holy place and everything in it will be in his care.

title: Numbers 4:17
text: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

title: Numbers 4:18
text: Do not let the family of the Kohathites be cut off from among the Levites;

title: Numbers 4:19
text: But do this to them, so that life and not death may be theirs when they come near the most holy things; let Aaron and his sons go in and give to every one his work and that which he is to take up;

title: Numbers 4:20
text: But they themselves are not to go in to see the holy place, even for a minute, for fear of death.

title: Numbers 4:21
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 4:22
text: Let the sons of Gershon be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

title: Numbers 4:23
text: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:24
text: This is to be the work of the Gershonites, the things they are to do and take up.

title: Numbers 4:25
text: They are to take up the curtains of the House, and the Tent of meeting with its cover and the leather cover over it, and the hangings for the door of the Tent of meeting;

title: Numbers 4:26
text: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, with the cords and all the things used for them; whatever is necessary for these, they are to do.

title: Numbers 4:27
text: From the mouth of Aaron and his sons the Gershonites will have word about all the things they are to do and take up; you are to give them their orders.

title: Numbers 4:28
text: This is the work of the family of the Gershonites in the Tent of meeting, and they will be under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:29
text: The sons of Merari are to be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

title: Numbers 4:30
text: Every one from thirty to fifty years old who is able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:31
text: And this is their part in the work of the Tent of meeting: the transport of the boards and the rods of the Tent, with the pillars and their bases;

title: Numbers 4:32
text: And the pillars of the open space outside it, with their bases and their nails and cords and all the instruments used, and everything which has to be done there; all the instruments for which they are responsible are to be numbered by name.

title: Numbers 4:33
text: This is the work which the sons of Merari are to do in connection with the Tent of meeting, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:34
text: ¶So Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people took in hand the numbering of the sons of the Kohathites, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

title: Numbers 4:35
text: Numbering all those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting;

title: Numbers 4:36
text: And the number of all these was two thousand, seven hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 4:37
text: This is the number of those of the Kohathites who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

title: Numbers 4:38
text: And those of the sons of Gershon who were numbered by families,

title: Numbers 4:39
text: All those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:40
text: Who were numbered by families in the order of their fathers' houses, were two thousand, six hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 4:41
text: This is the number of the sons of Gershon who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

title: Numbers 4:42
text: And those of the sons of Merari who were numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:43
text: All those from thirty to fifty years old who did the work in the Tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:44
text: Who were numbered by families, were three thousand, two hundred.

title: Numbers 4:45
text: This is the number of the sons of Merari, numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

title: Numbers 4:46
text: And all the Levites who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:47
text: Those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work of the Tent of meeting and of its transport,

title: Numbers 4:48
text: Came to eight thousand, five hundred and eighty.

title: Numbers 4:49
text: At the order of the Lord they were numbered by Moses, every one in relation to his work and to his part in the transport; so they were numbered by Moses at the order of the Lord.

title: Numbers 5:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 5:2
text: Give orders to the children of Israel to put outside the tent-circle every leper, and anyone who has any sort of flow from his body, and anyone who is unclean from the touch of the dead;

title: Numbers 5:3
text: Male or female they are to be put outside the tent-circle, so that they may not make unclean my resting-place among them.

title: Numbers 5:4
text: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had said to Moses, and put them outside the tent-circle.

title: Numbers 5:5
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 5:6
text: Say to the children of Israel, If a man or a woman does any of the sins of men, going against the word of the Lord, and is in the wrong;

title: Numbers 5:7
text: Let them say openly what they have done; and make payment for the wrong done, with the addition of a fifth part, and give it to him to whom the wrong was done.

title: Numbers 5:8
text: But if the man has no relation to whom the payment may be made, then the payment for sin made to the Lord will be the priest's, in addition to the sheep offered to take away his sin.

title: Numbers 5:9
text: And every offering lifted up of all the holy things which the children of Israel give to the priest, will be his.

title: Numbers 5:10
text: And every man's holy things will be his: whatever a man gives to the priest will be his.

title: Numbers 5:11
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 5:12
text: Say to the children of Israel, If any man's wife does wrong, sinning against him

title: Numbers 5:13
text: By taking as her lover another man, and keeps it secret so that her husband has no knowledge of it, and there is no witness against her, and she is not taken in the act;

title: Numbers 5:14
text: If the spirit of doubt comes into her husband's heart, and he has doubts of his wife, with good cause; or if he has doubts of her without cause:

title: Numbers 5:15
text: Then let him take her to the priest, offering for her the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal, without oil or perfume; for it is a meal offering of a bitter spirit, a meal offering keeping wrongdoing in mind.

title: Numbers 5:16
text: And the priest will make her come near and put her before the Lord;

title: Numbers 5:17
text: And the priest will take holy water in a pot and put in it dust from the floor of the House;

title: Numbers 5:18
text: And he will make the woman come before the Lord with her hair loose, and will put the meal offering, the offering of a bitter spirit, in her hands; and the priest will take in his hand the bitter water causing the curse;

title: Numbers 5:19
text: And he will make her take an oath, and say to her, If no man has been your lover and you have not been with another in place of your husband, you are free from this bitter water causing the curse;

title: Numbers 5:20
text: But if you have been with another in place of your husband and have made yourself unclean with a lover:

title: Numbers 5:21
text: Then the priest will put the oath of the curse on the woman, and say to her, May the Lord make you a curse and an oath among your people, sending on you wasting of the legs and disease of the stomach;

title: Numbers 5:22
text: And this water of the curse will go into your body, causing disease of your stomach and wasting of your legs: and the woman will say, So be it.

title: Numbers 5:23
text: And the priest will put these curses in a book, washing out the writing with the bitter water;

title: Numbers 5:24
text: And he will give to the woman the bitter water for drink; and the bitter water causing the curse will go into her.

title: Numbers 5:25
text: And the priest will take from her hand the meal offering of doubt, waving it before the Lord, and will take it to the altar;

title: Numbers 5:26
text: And he will take some of it in his hand, burning it on the altar as a sign, and then he will give the woman the bitter water.

title: Numbers 5:27
text: And it will be that if the woman has become unclean, sinning against her husband, when she has taken the bitter water it will go into her body, causing disease of the stomach and wasting of the legs, and she will be a curse among her people.

title: Numbers 5:28
text: But if she is clean she will be free and will have offspring.

title: Numbers 5:29
text: This is the law for testing a wife who goes with another in place of her husband and becomes unclean;

title: Numbers 5:30
text: Or for a husband who, in a bitter spirit, has doubts in his heart about his wife; let him take her to the priest, who will put in force this law.

title: Numbers 5:31
text: Then the man will be free from all wrong, and the woman's sin will be on her.

title: Numbers 6:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 6:2
text: Say to the children of Israel, If a man or a woman takes an oath to keep himself separate and give himself to the Lord;

title: Numbers 6:3
text: He is to keep himself from wine and strong drink, and take no mixed wine or strong drink or any drink made from grapes, or any grapes, green or dry.

title: Numbers 6:4
text: All the time he is separate he may take nothing made from the grape-vine, from its seeds to its skin.

title: Numbers 6:5
text: All the time he is under his oath let no blade come near his head; till the days while he is separate are ended he is holy and his hair may not be cut.

title: Numbers 6:6
text: All the time he is separate he may not come near any dead body.

title: Numbers 6:7
text: He may not make himself unclean for his father or his mother, his sister or his brother, if death comes to them; because he is under an oath to keep himself separate for God.

title: Numbers 6:8
text: All the time he is separate he is holy to the Lord.

title: Numbers 6:9
text: If death comes suddenly to a man at his side, so that he becomes unclean, let his hair be cut off on the day when he is made clean, on the seventh day.

title: Numbers 6:10
text: And on the eighth day let him take to the priest, at the door of the Tent of meeting, two doves or two young pigeons;

title: Numbers 6:11
text: And the priest will give one for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering to take away the sin which came on him on account of the dead, and he will make his head holy that same day.

title: Numbers 6:12
text: And he will give to the Lord his days of being separate, offering a he-lamb of the first year as an offering for error: but the earlier days will be a loss, because he became unclean.

title: Numbers 6:13
text: And this is the law for him who is separate, when the necessary days are ended: he is to come to the door of the Tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 6:14
text: And make his offering to the Lord; one he-lamb of the first year, without a mark, for a burned offering, and one female lamb of the first year, without a mark, for a sin-offering, and one male sheep, without a mark, for peace-offerings,

title: Numbers 6:15
text: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of the best meal mixed with oil, and thin unleavened cakes covered with oil, with their meal offering and drink offerings.

title: Numbers 6:16
text: And the priest will take them before the Lord, and make his sin-offering and his burned offering;

title: Numbers 6:17
text: Giving the sheep of the peace-offerings, with the basket of unleavened bread; and at the same time, the priest will make his meal offering and his drink offering.

title: Numbers 6:18
text: Then let his long hair, the sign of his oath, be cut off at the door of the Tent of meeting, and let him put it on the fire on which the peace-offerings are burning.

title: Numbers 6:19
text: And the priest will take the cooked leg of the sheep and one unleavened cake and one thin cake out of the basket, and put them on the hands of the separate one after his hair has been cut,

title: Numbers 6:20
text: Waving them for a wave offering before the Lord; this is holy for the priest, together with the waved breast and the leg which is lifted up; after that, the man may take wine.

title: Numbers 6:21
text: This is the law for him who takes an oath to keep himself separate, and for his offering to the Lord on that account, in addition to what he may be able to get; this is the law of his oath, which he will have to keep.

title: Numbers 6:22
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 6:23
text: Say to Aaron and his sons, These are the words of blessing which are to be used by you in blessing the children of Israel; say to them,

title: Numbers 6:24
text: May the Lord send his blessing on you and keep you:

title: Numbers 6:25
text: May the light of the Lord's face be shining on you in grace:

title: Numbers 6:26
text: May the Lord's approval be resting on you and may he give you peace.

title: Numbers 6:27
text: So they will put my name on the children of Israel, and I will give them my blessing.

title: Numbers 7:1
text: ¶And when Moses had put up the House completely, and had put oil on it and made it holy, with all the things in it, and had made the altar and all its vessels holy with oil;

title: Numbers 7:2
text: Then the chiefs of Israel, the heads of their fathers' houses, made offerings; these were the chiefs of the tribes, who were over those who were numbered.

title: Numbers 7:3
text: And they came with their offerings before the Lord, six covered carts and twelve oxen; a cart for every two of the chiefs, and for every one an ox.

title: Numbers 7:4
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 7:5
text: Take the things from them, to be used for the work of the Tent of meeting; and give them to the Levites, to every man what is needed for his work.

title: Numbers 7:6
text: So Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.

title: Numbers 7:7
text: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon for their work;

title: Numbers 7:8
text: And four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari for their work, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 7:9
text: But to the sons of Kohath he gave nothing; because they had the care of the holy place, taking it about on their backs.

title: Numbers 7:10
text: ¶And the chiefs gave an offering for the altar on the day when the holy oil was put on it; they made their offering before the altar.

title: Numbers 7:11
text: And the Lord said to Moses, Let every chief on his day give his offering to make the altar holy.

title: Numbers 7:12
text: And he who made his offering on the first day was Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

title: Numbers 7:13
text: And his offering was one silver plate, a hundred and thirty shekels in weight, one silver basin of seventy shekels, by the scale of the holy place; the two of them full of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering;

title: Numbers 7:14
text: One gold spoon of ten shekels, full of spice for burning;

title: Numbers 7:15
text: One young ox, one male sheep, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burned offering;

title: Numbers 7:16
text: One male of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:17
text: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 7:18
text: On the second day Nethanel, the son of Zuar, chief of Issachar, made his offering:

title: Numbers 7:19
text: He gave one silver plate, a hundred and thirty shekels in weight, one silver basin of seventy shekels, by the scale of the holy place; the two of them full of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering;

title: Numbers 7:20
text: One gold spoon of ten shekels, full of spice;

title: Numbers 7:21
text: One young ox, one male sheep, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burned offering;

title: Numbers 7:22
text: One male of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:23
text: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethanel, the son of Zuar.

title: Numbers 7:24
text: On the third day Eliab, the son of Helon, chief of the children of Zebulun:

title: Numbers 7:25
text: His offering was one silver plate, a hundred and thirty shekels in weight, one silver basin of seventy shekels, by the scale of the holy place; the two of them full of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering;

title: Numbers 7:26
text: One gold spoon of ten shekels, full of spice;

title: Numbers 7:27
text: One young ox, one male sheep, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burned offering;

title: Numbers 7:28
text: One male of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:29
text: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab, the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 7:30
text: On the fourth day Elizur, the son of Shedeur, chief of the children of Reuben:

title: Numbers 7:31
text: His offering was one silver plate, a hundred and thirty shekels in weight, one silver basin of seventy shekels, by the scale of the holy place; the two of them full of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering;

title: Numbers 7:32
text: One gold spoon of ten shekels, full of spice;

title: Numbers 7:33
text: One young ox, one male sheep, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burned offering;

title: Numbers 7:34
text: One male of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:35
text: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur, the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 7:36
text: On the fifth day Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, chief of the children of Simeon:

title: Numbers 7:37
text: His offering was one silver plate, a hundred and thirty shekels in weight, one silver basin of seventy shekels, by the scale of the holy place; the two of them full of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering;

title: Numbers 7:38
text: One gold spoon of ten shekels, full of spice;

title: Numbers 7:39
text: One young ox, one male sheep, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burned offering;

title: Numbers 7:40
text: One male of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:41
text: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 7:83
text: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira, the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 7:84
text: These were the offerings given for the altar by the chiefs of Israel, when the holy oil was put on it: twelve silver plates, twelve silver basins, twelve gold spoons;

title: Numbers 7:85
text: The weight of every silver plate was a hundred and thirty shekels, and of every basin seventy; the weight of all the silver of the vessels was two thousand and four hundred shekels, by the scale of the holy place;

title: Numbers 7:86
text: The weight of the twelve gold spoons of spice for burning was ten shekels for every one, by the scale of the holy place; all the gold of the spoons was a hundred and twenty shekels;

title: Numbers 7:87
text: All the oxen, for the burned offering were twelve, the male sheep twelve, the he-lambs of the first year twelve, with their meal offering; and the males of the goats for sin-offering twelve;

title: Numbers 7:88
text: And all the oxen for the peace-offerings, twenty-four oxen, the male sheep sixty, and the he-goats sixty, the he-lambs of the first year sixty. This was given for the altar after the holy oil was put on it.

title: Numbers 7:89
text: And when Moses went into the Tent of meeting to have talk with him, then the Voice came to his ears from over the cover which was on the ark of witness, from between the two winged ones. And he had talk with him.

title: Numbers 8:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 8:2
text: Say to Aaron, When you put the lights in their places, the seven lights will give light in front of the support.

title: Numbers 8:3
text: And Aaron did so; he put the lights in their places so that they gave light in front of the support, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Numbers 8:4
text: The support for the lights was of hammered gold work, from its base to its flowers it was of hammered work; from the design which the Lord had given to Moses, he made the support for the lights.

title: Numbers 8:5
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 8:6
text: Take the Levites out from among the children of Israel and make them clean.

title: Numbers 8:7
text: And this is how you are to make them clean: let the holy water which takes away sin be put on them, and let the hair all over their bodies be cut off with a sharp blade, and let their clothing be washed and their bodies made clean.

title: Numbers 8:8
text: Then let them take a young ox and its meal offering, crushed grain mixed with oil, and take another ox for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 8:9
text: And make the Levites come forward in front of the Tent of meeting, and let all the children of Israel come together:

title: Numbers 8:10
text: And you are to take the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel are to put their hands on them:

title: Numbers 8:11
text: And Aaron is to give the Levites to the Lord as a wave offering from the children of Israel, so that they may do the Lord's work.

title: Numbers 8:12
text: And the Levites are to put their hands on the heads of the oxen, and one of the oxen is to be offered for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering to the Lord to take away the sin of the Levites.

title: Numbers 8:13
text: Then the Levites are to be put before Aaron and his sons, to be offered as a wave offering to the Lord.

title: Numbers 8:14
text: So you are to make the Levites separate from the children of Israel, and the Levites will be mine.

title: Numbers 8:15
text: After that, the Levites will go in to do whatever has to be done in the Tent of meeting; you are to make them clean and give them as a wave offering.

title: Numbers 8:16
text: For they have been given to me from among the children of Israel; in place of every mother's first son, the first to come to birth in Israel, I have taken them for myself.

title: Numbers 8:17
text: For every mother's first son among the children of Israel is mine, the first male birth of man or beast: on the day when I sent death on all the first sons in the land of Egypt, I made them mine.

title: Numbers 8:18
text: And in place of the first sons among the children of Israel, I have taken the Levites.

title: Numbers 8:19
text: And I have given them to Aaron and to his sons, from among the children of Israel, to undertake for them all the work of the Tent of meeting, and to take away sin from the children of Israel so that no evil may come on them when they come near the holy place.

title: Numbers 8:20
text: All these things Moses and Aaron and the children of Israel did to the Levites; as the Lord gave orders to Moses about the Levites, so the children of Israel did.

title: Numbers 8:21
text: And the Levites were made clean from sin, and their clothing was washed, and Aaron gave them for a wave offering before the Lord; and Aaron took away their sin and made them clean.

title: Numbers 8:22
text: And then the Levites went in to do their work in the Tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons: all the orders which the Lord had given Moses about the Levites were put into effect.

title: Numbers 8:23
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 8:24
text: This is the rule for the Levites: those of twenty-five years old and over are to go in and do the work of the Tent of meeting;

title: Numbers 8:25
text: But after they are fifty years old, they are to give up their work and do no more;

title: Numbers 8:26
text: But be with their brothers in the Tent of meeting, taking care of it but doing no work. This is what you are to do in connection with the Levites and their work.

title: Numbers 9:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses, in the waste land of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt,

title: Numbers 9:2
text: Let the children of Israel keep the Passover at its regular time.

title: Numbers 9:3
text: In the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you are to keep it at the regular time, and in the way ordered in the law.

title: Numbers 9:4
text: And Moses gave orders to the children of Israel to keep the Passover.

title: Numbers 9:5
text: So they kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at evening, in the waste land of Sinai: as the Lord gave orders to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

title: Numbers 9:6
text: And there were certain men who were unclean because of a dead body, so that they were not able to keep the Passover on that day; and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

title: Numbers 9:7
text: And these men said to him, We have been made unclean by the dead body of a man; why may we not make the offering of the Lord at the regular time among the children of Israel?

title: Numbers 9:8
text: And Moses said to them, Do nothing till the Lord gives me directions about you.

title: Numbers 9:9
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 9:10
text: Say to the children of Israel, If any one of you or of your families is unclean because of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, still he is to keep the Passover to the Lord:

title: Numbers 9:11
text: In the second month, on the fourteenth day, in the evening, they are to keep it, taking it with unleavened bread and bitter-tasting plants;

title: Numbers 9:12
text: Nothing of it is to be kept till the morning, and no bone of it is to be broken: they are to keep it by the rules of the Passover.

title: Numbers 9:13
text: But the man who, not being unclean or on a journey, does not keep the Passover, will be cut off from his people: because he did not make the offering of the Lord at the regular time, his sin will be on him.

title: Numbers 9:14
text: And if a man from another country is among you and has a desire to keep the Passover to the Lord, let him do as is ordered in the law of the Passover: there is to be the same rule for the man from another nation and for him who had his birth in the land.

title: Numbers 9:15
text: ¶And on the day when the House was put up, the cloud came down on it, on the Tent of witness; and in the evening there was a light like fire over the House till the morning.

title: Numbers 9:16
text: And so it was at all times: it was covered by the cloud, and by a light as of fire by night.

title: Numbers 9:17
text: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the House, then the children of Israel went journeying on; and in the place where the cloud came to rest, there the children of Israel put up their tents.

title: Numbers 9:18
text: At the order of the Lord the children of Israel went forward, and at the order of the Lord they put up their tents: as long as the cloud was resting on the House, they did not go away from that place.

title: Numbers 9:19
text: When the cloud was resting on the House for a long time the children of Israel, waiting for the order of the Lord, did not go on.

title: Numbers 9:20
text: Sometimes the cloud was resting on the House for two or three days; then, by the order of the Lord, they kept their tents in that place, and when the Lord gave the order they went on.

title: Numbers 9:21
text: And sometimes the cloud was there only from evening to morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning they went on their journey again: or if it was resting there by day and by night, whenever the cloud was taken up they went forward.

title: Numbers 9:22
text: Or if the cloud came to rest on the House for two days or a month or a year without moving, the children of Israel went on waiting there and did not go on; but whenever it was taken up they went forward on their journey.

title: Numbers 9:23
text: At the word of the Lord they put up their tents, and at the word of the Lord they went forward on their journey: they kept the orders of the Lord as he gave them by Moses.

title: Numbers 10:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Numbers 10:2
text: Make two silver horns of hammered work, to be used for getting the people together and to give the sign for the moving of the tents.

title: Numbers 10:3
text: When they are sounded, all the people are to come together to you at the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 10:4
text: If only one of them is sounded, then the chiefs, the heads of the thousands of Israel, are to come to you.

title: Numbers 10:5
text: When a loud note is sounded, the tents placed on the east side are to go forward.

title: Numbers 10:6
text: At the sound of a second loud note, the tents on the south side are to go forward: the loud note will be the sign to go forward.

title: Numbers 10:7
text: But when all the people are to come together, the horn is to be sounded but not loudly.

title: Numbers 10:8
text: The horns are to be sounded by the sons of Aaron, the priests; this is to be a law for you for ever, from generation to generation.

title: Numbers 10:9
text: And if you go to war in your land against any who do you wrong, then let the loud note of the horn be sounded; and the Lord your God will keep you in mind and give you salvation from those who are against you.

title: Numbers 10:10
text: And on days of joy and on your regular feasts and on the first day of every month, let the horns be sounded over your burned offerings and your peace-offerings; and they will put the Lord in mind of you: I am the Lord your God.

title: Numbers 10:11
text: ¶Now in the second year, on the twentieth day of the second month, the cloud was taken up from over the Tent of witness.

title: Numbers 10:12
text: And the children of Israel went on their journey out of the waste land of Sinai; and the cloud came to rest in the waste land of Paran.

title: Numbers 10:13
text: They went forward for the first time on their journey as the Lord had given orders by the hand of Moses.

title: Numbers 10:14
text: First the flag of the children of Judah went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 10:15
text: And at the head of the army of the children of Issachar was Nethanel, the son of Zuar.

title: Numbers 10:16
text: And at the head of the army of the children of Zebulun was Eliab, the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 10:17
text: Then the House was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who were responsible for moving the House, went forward.

title: Numbers 10:18
text: Then the flag of the children of Reuben went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Elizur, the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 10:19
text: And at the head of the army of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 10:20
text: At the head of the army of the children of Gad was Eliasaph, the son of Reuel.

title: Numbers 10:21
text: Then the Kohathites went forward with the holy place; the others put up the House ready for their coming.

title: Numbers 10:22
text: Then the flag of the children of Ephraim went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Elishama, the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 10:23
text: At the head of the army of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur.

title: Numbers 10:24
text: At the head of the army of the children of Benjamin was Abidan, the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 10:25
text: And the flag of the children of Dan, whose tents were moved last of all, went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai.

title: Numbers 10:26
text: At the head of the army of the children of Asher was Pagiel, the son of Ochran.

title: Numbers 10:27
text: And at the head of the army of the children of Naphtali was Ahira, the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 10:28
text: This was the order in which the children of Israel were journeying by armies; so they went forward.

title: Numbers 10:29
text: ¶Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of his father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, We are journeying to that place of which the Lord has said, I will give it to you: so come with us, and it will be for your profit: for the Lord has good things in store for Israel.

title: Numbers 10:30
text: But he said, I will not go with you, I will go back to the land of my birth and to my relations.

title: Numbers 10:31
text: And he said, Do not go from us; for you will be eyes for us, guiding us to the right places in the waste land to put up our tents.

title: Numbers 10:32
text: And if you come with us, we will give you a part in whatever good the Lord does for us.

title: Numbers 10:33
text: So they went forward three days' journey from the mountain of the Lord; and the ark of the Lord's agreement went three days' journey before them, looking for a resting-place for them;

title: Numbers 10:34
text: And by day the cloud of the Lord went over them, when they went forward from the place where they had put up their tents.

title: Numbers 10:35
text: And when the ark went forward Moses said, Come up, O Lord, and let the armies of those who are against you be broken, and let your haters go in flight before you.

title: Numbers 10:36
text: And when it came to rest, he said, Take rest, O Lord, and give a blessing to the families of Israel.

title: Numbers 11:1
text: ¶Now the people were saying evil against the Lord; and the Lord, hearing it, was angry and sent fire on them, burning the outer parts of the tent-circle.

title: Numbers 11:2
text: And the people made an outcry to Moses, and Moses made prayer to the Lord, and the fire was stopped.

title: Numbers 11:3
text: So that place was named Taberah, because of the fire of the Lord which had been burning among them.

title: Numbers 11:4
text: ¶And the mixed band of people who went with them were overcome by desire: and the children of Israel, weeping again, said, Who will give us flesh for our food?

title: Numbers 11:5
text: Sweet is the memory of the fish we had in Egypt for nothing, and the fruit and green plants of every sort, sharp and pleasing to the taste:

title: Numbers 11:6
text: But now our soul is wasted away; there is nothing at all: we have nothing but this manna before our eyes.

title: Numbers 11:7
text: Now the manna was like a seed of grain, like small clear drops.

title: Numbers 11:8
text: The people went about taking it up from the earth, crushing it between stones or hammering it to powder, and boiling it in pots, and they made cakes of it: its taste was like the taste of cakes cooked with oil.

title: Numbers 11:9
text: When the dew came down on the tents at night, the manna came down with it.

title: Numbers 11:10
text: And at the sound of the people weeping, every man at his tent-door, the wrath of the Lord was great, and Moses was very angry.

title: Numbers 11:11
text: And Moses said to the Lord, Why have you done me this evil? and why have I not grace in your eyes, that you have put on me the care of all this people?

title: Numbers 11:12
text: Am I the father of all this people? have I given them birth, that you say to me, Take them in your arms, like a child at the breast, to the land which you gave by an oath to their fathers?

title: Numbers 11:13
text: Where am I to get flesh to give to all this people? For they are weeping to me and saying, Give us flesh for our food.

title: Numbers 11:14
text: I am not able by myself to take the weight of all this people, for it is more than my strength.

title: Numbers 11:15
text: If this is to be my fate, put me to death now in answer to my prayer, if I have grace in your eyes; and let me not see my shame.

title: Numbers 11:16
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses, Send for seventy of the responsible men of Israel, who are in your opinion men of weight and authority over the people; make them come to the Tent of meeting and be there with you.

title: Numbers 11:17
text: And I will come down and have talk with you there: and I will take some of the spirit which is on you and put it on them, and they will take part of the weight of the people off you, so that you do not have to take it by yourself.

title: Numbers 11:18
text: And say to the people, Make yourselves clean before tomorrow and you will have flesh for your food: for in the ears of the Lord you have been weeping and saying, Who will give us flesh for food? for we were well off in Egypt: and so the Lord will give you flesh, and it will be your food;

title: Numbers 11:19
text: Not for one day only, or even for five or ten or twenty days;

title: Numbers 11:20
text: But every day for a month, till you are tired of it, turning from it in disgust: because you have gone against the Lord who is with you, and have been weeping before him saying, Why did we come out of Egypt?

title: Numbers 11:21
text: Then Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, I will give them flesh to be their food for a month.

title: Numbers 11:22
text: Are flocks and herds to be put to death for them? or are all the fish in the sea to be got together so that they may be full?

title: Numbers 11:23
text: And the Lord said to Moses, Has the Lord's hand become short? Now you will see if my word comes true for you or not.

title: Numbers 11:24
text: ¶And Moses went out and gave the people the words of the Lord: and he took seventy of the responsible men of the people, placing them round the Tent.

title: Numbers 11:25
text: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and had talk with him, and put on the seventy men some of the spirit which was on him: now when the spirit came to rest on them, they were like prophets, but only at that time.

title: Numbers 11:26
text: But two men were still in the tent-circle one of them named Eldad and the other Medad: and the spirit came to rest on them; they were among those who had been sent for, but they had not gone out to the Tent: and the prophet's power came on them in the tent-circle.

title: Numbers 11:27
text: And a young man went running to Moses and said, Eldad and Medad are acting as prophets in the tent-circle.

title: Numbers 11:28
text: Then Joshua, the son of Nun, who had been Moses' servant from the time when he was a child, said, My lord Moses, let them be stopped.

title: Numbers 11:29
text: And Moses said to him, Are you moved by envy on my account? If only all the Lord's people were prophets, and the Lord might put his spirit on them!

title: Numbers 11:30
text: Then Moses, with the responsible men of Israel, went back to the tent-circle.

title: Numbers 11:31
